about: Test questions for the agent, answered against the synthetic dataset (seed 42, demo today = 2026-11-16). 'expect' is what a correct answer must say; 'must_not' is what the answer checks should block.

questions.question: Do busy days affect my mood?
questions.expect: Yes: after days with 7h+ booked, next-day mood is clearly lower. Stated as a correlation over ~60 days.

questions.question: Does short sleep affect how ready I feel?
questions.expect: Yes: mornings after under 6h of sleep have much lower readiness. Few short nights (~11), so the answer should mention the sample size.

questions.question: What happens to my sleep after late events?
questions.expect: Nights after an event ending 9:30pm or later average roughly an hour less sleep.

questions.question: Do workouts help my mood?
questions.expect: Mood the day after a workout is higher than after non-workout days. Correlation, not causation.

questions.question: Why do I walk less on some days?
questions.expect: Class days (Mon-Thu with lectures) have about 2-3k fewer steps.

questions.question: Are my steps related to my HRV?
questions.expect: No meaningful relationship. The agent should say the data does not show a pattern.

questions.question: How's next week looking?
questions.expect: Thursday Nov 19 is the heaviest day (8h+), after a late Wednesday. Warns about Thursday and Friday; the weekend is light.

questions.question: When am I free on Thursday Nov 19?
questions.expect: Real gaps only, e.g. 12:15-16:00 between the lecture and the library shift. Never inside a booked event.

questions.question: How did last week compare to the week before?
questions.expect: A Nov 9-15 vs Nov 2-8 comparison of sleep, readiness, mood, steps and workouts, with every number traceable to a tool result.

questions.question: Did coffee make me sleep worse?
questions.expect: There is no caffeine data. The agent says it can't answer instead of guessing.
must_not: any number about coffee or caffeine
